name: streamline-icons
description: Search and download Streamline icons, illustrations and design elements.

interface.longDescription:
Search the Streamline library of icons, illustrations and emojis, and download the ones you pick as SVG or PNG.

Describe what you need in plain language, such as a concept, a UI element or a visual style, and Streamline returns matching assets to preview and download.

You can also ask which icon family suits your product, browse the sets inside a family, and get advice on picking clear, consistent icon metaphors for your interface or design system.
defaultPrompt: Which icon sets pair well with Inter font?
Find me a line-style icon for notifications
Search for illustrations related to teamwork

positive.description: Recommend an icon family for a typeface
positive.prompt: Which icon sets pair well with Inter font?
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends one Streamline icon family that suits Inter, such as Core, explains the fit in terms of stroke, geometry and neutrality, and shows that family's sets with their preview images.

positive.description: Find an icon for a UI concept
positive.prompt: Find me a line-style icon for notifications
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a few line-style bell or notification icons with preview images and the set each one belongs to.

positive.prompt: Search for illustrations related to teamwork
positive.expected_behavior: Returns teamwork illustrations, such as Team Work from the London set, with preview images and set names.

positive.prompt: Download a ringing bell notification icon from Core Line Free as a 24px SVG
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Ringing Bell Notification icon in the Core Line Free set and returns a short-lived download link to the SVG file.

positive.description: Find a consistent group of icons
positive.prompt: I need icons for save, edit, delete and share in my app toolbar. Find them in one consistent style.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one icon for each of the four actions, all from the same icon family, with preview images.

negative.description: Image generation is out of scope
negative.prompt: Generate a photorealistic image of a cat sitting on a sofa.
What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Cancel my Streamline subscription and delete my account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search Streamline icons, illustrations and emojis, get icon family recommendations, and download assets as SVG or PNG.
